excerpt: How to Prove a Genuine Relationship in Canadian Spousal Sponsorship Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Spousal sponsorship is one of the most common and compassionate immigration pathways in Canada. Through this program, Canadian citizens and permanent residents can sponsor their spouse or partner for permanent residence. But the success of any spousal sponsorship application depends heavily on proving that the relationship is genuine and not entered into for immigration purposes.
